memory_update.text: LANC is the cleanest public underfollowed candidate for the sauces/dressings/condiments restaurant-input node because its Foodservice segment explicitly references custom-formulated sauces and salad dressings for national chain restaurant accounts.

Private Ventura Foods strongly validates the hidden-supplier chokepoint: oils, sauces, dressings, mayonnaise, butter blends, and seasonings are supplied behind Sysco brands and top restaurant-chain menus, but Ventura itself is not publicly listed.
MKC should be retained as a reference leader, not an alpha-hunt focus, because it is a high-attention large-cap flavor-solutions benchmark with direct foodservice exposure.
BGS and THS require Layer 2 verification of current foodservice/private-label sauce, dressing, condiment, and restaurant-chain exposure before they can graduate beyond speculative-shadow status.

node: Sauces, oils, dressings, condiments, mayonnaise, butter blends, and seasonings
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around restaurant flavor inputs rather than restaurant operators. The strongest public mapping is Lancaster Colony / The Marzetti Company, whose foodservice business explicitly includes custom-formulated sauces and salad dressings for national chain restaurant accounts. McCormick is the obvious large-cap reference for customized flavor solutions, seasonings, condiments, and foodservice customers. B&G Foods and TreeHouse Foods are included as weaker underfollowed hypotheses because both touch sauces, dressings, seasonings, condiments, foodservice, or private-label channels, but their current restaurant-chain dependency and node purity require verification. Private Ventura Foods, evidenced as a major supplier to Sysco and top chains, validates the chokepoint logic but is not itself a US-listed candidate.
